beats.why: The scale diagram suggests creativity lies on a spectrum rather than conveying that Mozart was a manufactured prodigy.
Crossing out "A BAD WRITER" caused the viewer to think the label was rejected, whereas his father actually called him one.
Crossing out "THROWN COMPLETELY OUT" implies being thrown out is rejected, contradicting the narration that gut instinct is indeed discarded.
Crossing out "NOT CORPORATE SLUDGE" creates a double negative implying the works are corporate sludge, contradicting the narrator.
The refute diagram has an empty label so the viewer only sees an abstract refutation without knowing what is being refuted.
